summary: A row of related buttons sharing one border, in four shapes, with optional rules between them.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the group. `pill` also insets the buttons, so a pill `Button` inside sits clear of the border.

props.name: separated
props.description: Draws a rule between each pair of buttons. Turn it off when the buttons already carry their own edges.

props.name: stretch
props.description: Buttons share the full width instead of sizing to their labels.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with the group's own classes, so a utility you pass wins.
